scenes.title: Scangos, Chang & Krystal (2021): Closed-Loop Amygdala-Guided Brain Pacemaker for Severe De
scenes.era: 2021, UCSF Weill Institute for Neurosciences, University of California, San Francisco

layout.description: Katherine Scangos, Edward Chang, Andrew Krystal, and colleagues (Nature Medicine, Oct 2021) mapped a 36-year-old woman ('Sarah') with severe treatment-resistant depression using 10 days of multi-site intracranial stereo-EEG, discovering a right-amygdala gamma biomarker that predicted symptom spikes with 87% accuracy and triggered a closed-loop ventral striatum pacemaker (~300 six-second pulses/day) that dropped her MADRS depression score from 36 to 10!
